scope: private instructor draft; analytical and linear-map reference figures

figures.coffee: Positive normalized temperature excess on log y; same fixed-bath exponential model.
figures.growth: Constant fractional growth normalized to its initial value.
figures.doubling: Growth reaches twice and four times its initial value after one and two doubling times.
figures.decay: Exact positive exponential decay on log y with explicit half-population ticks.
figures.sign: Positive exponential growth and decay on log y; opposite straight-line slopes.
figures.water: Hydrostatic pressure increases linearly with downward depth for constant density and gravity.
figures.planet-mass: Exact normalized enclosed mass of a constant-density sphere: m/M=(r/R)^3.
figures.planet-pressure: Exact normalized pressure of a constant-density hydrostatic sphere with zero surface pressure: P/P_c=1−(r/R)^2.
figures.planet-profiles: Analytic constant-density limiting case, not a computed rocky-planet EOS result.
figures.hse-balance: Outward inner pressure force, inward outer pressure force and gravity on a thin spherical shell; qualitative vectors, not force magnitudes.
figures.mass-shell: Spherical shell radii r and r+dr; enclosed mass label; differential shell volume4πr²dr.
figures.variables: Independent variable, unknown state, and derivative identified separately.
figures.order-definition: Order is the highest derivative present; both first- and second-order examples are ODEs.
figures.conditions: The pieces of a specified initial-value numerical experiment.
figures.closure: Density closure joins radial mass and pressure equations into a specified planet model.
figures.compute: Computable derivatives lead to an approximate solution with explicit numerical checks.
figures.update-flow: Euler computes all coupled slopes from the same old state.
figures.shooting: Shooting wraps center-to-surface IVP integrations in an outer root solve.
figures.surface: Surface location is a separate numerical operation from the ODE update.
figures.diagnostics: State, energy, and phase measurements answer different questions.
figures.tests: Distinct test problems expose distinct solver implementation mistakes.
figures.euler-tangent: Euler follows the initial tangent for u′=−u; the convex exact decay lies above it.
figures.decay-step: One Euler step from u(0)=1 with h=0.2 gives 0.8; the exact endpoint is about 0.818731.
figures.decay-resolved: Euler scalar decay test with h=0.25: amplification factor 0.75.
figures.decay-negative: Euler scalar decay test with h=1.5: amplification factor -0.5.
figures.decay-unstable: Euler scalar decay test with h=3.0: amplification factor -2.0.
figures.global-error: Original five Euler steps, focused linear y range, endpoint error marked.
figures.slope-field: Two initial values select different exact curves in the same slope field dy/dx=y.
figures.grids: Coarse and fine coordinate grids end at exactly the same final coordinate.
figures.spring-force: Linear spring force is opposite positive displacement: F=−kx.
figures.oscillator-traces: Exact scaled oscillator from initial state (q,p)=(1,0).
figures.phase-circle: Equal-scale q,p phase plane. Points on the same energy circle can have different phase.
figures.euler-phase: Equal-scale q,p phase plane. Euler h=0.1 over scaled duration12 spirals outward.
figures.rk-stage-1: RK4 stage input states for y′=y, initial value1, step0.1; highlighted stage 1.
figures.rk-stage-2: RK4 stage input states for y′=y, initial value1, step0.1; highlighted stage 2.
figures.rk-stage-3: RK4 stage input states for y′=y, initial value1, step0.1; highlighted stage 3.
figures.rk-stage-4: RK4 stage input states for y′=y, initial value1, step0.1; highlighted stage 4.
figures.midpoint: Explicit midpoint stages for y′=y and step0.1, keeping the original base state.
figures.stage-growth: Log absolute differences at the original trial midpoint (x=.05,y=1.05) and endpoint (x=.1,y=1.105), each compared with exp(x). No connecting error trajectory implied.
figures.order: Common-endpoint oscillator errors at T=2 using h=0.1 halved four times; linear reference maps only.
figures.rhs-work: Derivative evaluation counts are a work model, not measured runtime.
figures.energy: Absolute relative energy error on log y. Exact zeros masked, no artificial floor; frozen 100 steps per period, 20 periods.
figures.phase-error: Absolute phase error on log y. Exact zeros masked; frozen oscillator experiment, same step and duration.
figures.rk4-energy: Magnified RK4 physical-energy error for the same oscillator experiment; RK4 does not preserve energy exactly.
figures.kick1: Kick–drift–kick for a separable mechanical Hamiltonian; highlighted substep.
figures.drift: Kick–drift–kick for a separable mechanical Hamiltonian; highlighted substep.
figures.kick2: Kick–drift–kick for a separable mechanical Hamiltonian; highlighted substep.
figures.symplectic: Symplectic structure, state accuracy, and physical energy are separate claims.
figures.method-summary: The appropriate evidence depends on the model and on the quantity being reported.
figures.modified-invariant: h=1, unit oscillator, K_h=(p²+.75q²)/2; circle and ellipse are exact level sets through(1,0).
figures.stiff-transient: u′=−1000u, u₀=1, h=.01, t from0to.03; exact and backward-Euler amplification.
figures.adaptive-flow: Accept/reject schematic; no numerical tolerance is selected.
figures.simpson: Exact quadratic g(x)=1+x+x², x from0to1; nodes0,.5,1, weights1,4,1; exact integral11/6.
figures.state-examples: Authored scientific reference diagram for the approved 40-frame storyboard revision.
figures.heat-profiles: Authored scientific reference diagram for the approved 40-frame storyboard revision.
figures.rk-stages-12: Authored scientific reference diagram for the approved 40-frame storyboard revision.
figures.rk-stages-34: Authored scientific reference diagram for the approved 40-frame storyboard revision.
figures.rk-stages-all: Authored scientific reference diagram for the approved 40-frame storyboard revision.
figures.kick-drift-kick: Authored scientific reference diagram for the approved 40-frame storyboard revision.
figures.rk2-phase: Exact, Euler, and explicit midpoint RK2 on identical axes for the existing phase experiment.
figures.rk4-phase: Exact, Euler, RK2, and classical RK4 on identical axes for the existing phase experiment.
figures.phase-endpoint-zoom: Magnified terminal phase-plane states for RK2, RK4, and exact at T=12, with equal axis scales.
figures.rk4-endpoint-zoom: Equal-axis terminal phase-plane offsets from exact, multiplied by 1e6, showing nonzero RK4 error at unchanged h=0.1 and T=12.
figures.decay-magnitude: Exact and Euler magnitudes for already introduced h=0.25,1.5,3; same u0=1 and time interval0to9. Signed panel retained.
figures.rk2-endpoint-zoom: Equal-axis RK2 versus exact terminal phase-plane view for unchanged h=.1,T=12; RK4 not yet introduced.

heat_profile_reference.variables: dimensionless x and t, normalized temperature excess

verification.method: central differences of time and space derivatives at 12 points
verification.scope: illustrative exact-reference figure only; no generic numerical solver claim

plot_generation.renderer: Matplotlib SVG output from MyST-executed notebook
plot_generation.reference_maps_and_experiments: unchanged; checked against frozen order_ratios and geometry_results
plot_generation.live_example: growth frame; slide-python with notebook fallback

phase_comparison_configuration.model: q prime=p; p prime=-q; undamped scaled oscillator
phase_comparison_configuration.basis: Existing Euler phase-diagram experiment; same step and endpoint, not equal derivative cost.
phase_comparison_configuration.endpoint_zoom: Equal axis scales; window derived from exact and RK2 endpoints. RK4 and exact nearly overlap at this scale.

visibility_revision.energy: logarithmic magnitude, signed RK4 detail retained
visibility_revision.zero_handling: masked; no positive error floor substituted

axis_review.style_consistency: RK2 label in order plot; purple RK4 in energy detail.
